info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Airline Flights Status-v1-spec
info.description: This API provides access to the current status of airline flights, enabling users to retrieve real-time information about flight conditions. It serves as a valuable resource for travelers, airline staff, and applications needing to monitor flight operations. By querying this endpoint, consumers can quickly check on flight availability, delays, and cancellations. The API supports various integrations, ensuring that stakeholders can maintain up-to-date insights into flight statuses.

get.summary: Retrieve the status of a flight.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to check the current status of a specific flight, providing information such as whether it is on time, delayed, or cancelled.
